Description The design of an AUTOSAR System involves the creation of a T opology , ECU Resources Descriptions, and the interconnection between ECU instances. The software components defined within the VFB T op Level System Composition are then deployed to the ECU instances. The required network signals are identified and a mapping is done to System Signals to implement the VFB. System Signal Groups, are defined to keep certain signals grouped together for atomic transmission. System Signals are then defined and form the initial input to design the Communication Matrix.
